gates.label: Finite model search and seven-fold refits
gates.detail: All planned original and follow-up attempts are terminal; training-selected exact-J representatives passed numerical acceptance. Finite protocol does not prove a global optimum.

gates.label: Selectable research model package
gates.detail: Four frozen models explicitly selectable; all 2,608 reference values replay within 1 Hz. Production remains i2spec2026o.

gates.label: Error and sensitivity audit
gates.detail: 32 selected cohorts and 64 accepted starts reconciled. Balanced routine RMS 156.36 kHz, worst 576.20 kHz; withheld B(39) RMS 3.44 MHz. Folds overlap.

gates.label: Prospective predictions and scoring
gates.detail: 192 forecasts for 48 components on 16 lines / 8 pairs, immutable coefficients/primary/thresholds/envelopes; input templates and scoring prepared. All 384 mesh/box comparisons pass; maximum change 18.72 Hz.

gates.label: Fresh laboratory validation
gates.detail: User reports no new measurements. All 48 prospective targets remain pending; laser/assignment feasibility and traceability require laboratory review.

gates.label: Published external comparison
gates.detail: Two 2025 candidate papers retained. Kondo exact result unavailable; experimental correction and uncertainty conventions unverified for both. Zero comparable outcomes scored.

gates.label: Calibrated prediction probability
gates.detail: Empirical half-widths 0.6 / 13 MHz carry no assigned probability. Full covariance and independent coverage calibration are unavailable; no 95% interval or universal accuracy claim.
